0022600218.text: The Cavaliers (5-6) come in on a two-game losing streak, sitting second in the Central and 2.5 games back, and they are 1-4 on the road this season, while the Knicks (6-4) are on a four-game winning streak and sit third in the Atlantic, also 2.5 games back. New York leads the season series 1-0 after winning 109-97 in Cleveland on November 7, and the Cavaliers lost the 2025-26 regular-season series 1-2 and the 2025-26 playoff series 0-4. Cleveland will be without Jaylon Tyson (ankle sprain) and Sam Merrill (elbow), both listed as out, while New York will be without Josh Hart (illness, out) and Karl-Anthony Towns, who is day-to-day with calf soreness and a game-time decision.
